title: 3.7.18 Lab: Build a New Object with Spread + Override
description: Use object spread to copy an object with one property overridden and one property added, leaving the original untouched. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Create the base object
steps.instructions: Create a variable called settings and assign it an object with at least three properties.

steps.title: Copy with one property overridden
steps.instructions: Use object spread to build a copy of settings with one existing property changed. The override must be written after the spread.

steps.title: Copy with a new property added
steps.instructions: Use object spread again to build a second copy with a new property that settings did not have.

steps.title: Log all three objects
steps.instructions: Use console.log to print both copies and the original settings object. Confirm the original is unchanged.

requirements.title: Object declared
requirements.description: Declares an object with curly braces

requirements.title: Object spread used
requirements.description: Uses object spread, written as ... inside an object literal

requirements.title: Override after the spread
requirements.description: Writes a property after the spread so the override wins
